VA Home Loan Webinar

Save my seat

What this covers

A plain-English walkthrough of the VA home loan benefit: what you have earned, what it actually costs, and how to use it without getting talked into something that does not fit. Bring your questions. We answer them live at the end.

  • How VA entitlement works, and what $0 down really means for your payment
  • The VA funding fee, who is exempt, and how exemptions get applied
  • VA versus conventional and FHA: an honest comparison, not a sales pitch
  • Using your benefit more than once, and what happens to entitlement when you keep a home
  • BAH, PCS timing, and buying before or after you report to a new duty station
  • Credit, debt-to-income, and residual income: what underwriters are actually looking at

Who it is for

  • Veterans and active-duty service members buying a first or next home
  • Anyone who was told they could not use their VA benefit and wants a second opinion
  • Surviving spouses who may be eligible and have never been walked through it
